Chloe / all,

Thanks for the context. From an accounting controls perspective I recommend issuing a credit memo to Shoply (AR) rather than an intercompany contra if Shoply is an external customer — this preserves an auditable trail in AR and ties cleanly to revenue recognition adjustments.

If we issue a credit memo:
- Posting: Debit Sales Returns & Allowances (G/L 7205) and Credit Accounts Receivable (G/L 1102) at the customer level.
- Memo reference: use deal id DL-03892 + date 2027-06-20.
- Invoice offset: Shoply can net against next invoice; we should still record a standalone credit memo for their records.

If for any reason Shoply requests an intercompany contra (they said different finance teams), we need a memo explaining why and an intercompany clearing entry:
- Debit Sales (G/L 4000) and Credit Intercompany Payable (G/L 2201) at the hosting subsidiary; offset with Intercompany Receivable at the buyer entity.

Happy to draft the credit memo text. Marcus
